findings.title: Pinned 0002 header and acceptance 1 say Django 5.2.17, but backend/.venv has Django 5.2.18 (pyproject pins >=5.2,<5.3), so a correctly generated file fails acceptance 1 as written (only the date is excused) and the hand-write fallback would carry a false provenance line
findings.fix: Compare the generated file against the pinned body only (exclude the whole '# Generated by ...' line); write the pinned header as 'Django <installed version>'; a hand-written fallback uses the version django.get_version() reports (5.2.18) and is reported as hand-written

findings.title: 'Iterate read_output() once' does not say how each pass terminates
findings.fix: Each pass is `for line in handle.read_output(): lines.append(line); if "done" in line: break` as in today's test; flush_remaining() appended to the guarded pass only; no timeout_s

findings.title: RunHistoryView.test.jsx:56 comment 'One Run per Run_Status in Run.STATUS_CHOICES' becomes false once failed is added but RUNS is left unchanged
findings.fix: Reword to 'One Run per Run_Status other than failed, which has its own test below' and list it among comments rewritten in the same change
